name: GitHub Work Intake
description: Acquire GitHub work read-only through an approved fixed-host gh boundary and bounded budget, emit normalized-intake.v1, and delegate repository routing to work-intake.

deps._runtime_contract: Skills are addressed by registered name; source values are install guidance only.

skills.name: work-intake
skills.purpose: Classification and all repository mutation; hard dependency with no fallback.

artifacts: One validated normalized-intake.v1 envelope handed to work-intake.
